What's new in this build

Google sign-in & guest mode

  • Google ID token verified server-side (JWKS, audience, issuer, expiry)
  • Client ID and on/off switch live in Admin → Authentication
  • Optional guest browsing — turn it off to force sign-in
  • Accounts link by Google ID or verified email

Downloads, copyright & live

  • Per-video download permission + platform switch, token-protected streaming
  • DMCA / copyright claim form with admin review queue
  • Live streams with ingest credentials, HLS URL and polling live chat
  • Device/push token registry, ad placements and monetization profiles

Large video uploads

  • Resumable chunked upload (1.6 MB chunks) — big files no longer fail with "Post data is too large"
  • Upload limits endpoint: /api/v1/videos/upload/limits
  • Clear 413 / 422 messages in the app
  • 512 MB PHP limits pre-set in .user.ini + .htaccess

Reliability fixes

  • Like / dislike counters can no longer underflow (fixed a 500 on toggle)
  • Unsubscribe, comment delete, playlist remove use the same safe counters
  • Admin settings no longer switch off features from other groups
  • Full API regression suite: 26 checks passing

cPanel installation in 4 steps

1

Create the database

cPanel → MySQL Databases → create DB + user, grant ALL PRIVILEGES.

2

Upload & extract

Upload ittube-backend.zip to /home/USER/ and extract. Copy public_html_files/* into public_html/.

3

Run /install

Open https://api.adsxuit.com/install, enter DB + admin details, click Install. The wizard writes .env with a fresh app key.

4

Go live

Admin: /admin · API: /api/v1/app/config. The installer locks itself automatically.
